description:
Free, open-source video downloader for YouTube and 2000+ other sites. Save videos, playlists, channels and audio in up to 8K HDR, and sign in through the built-in browser for private or members-only videos. No ads.

Arroxy is a free, open-source desktop app for downloading video and audio from YouTube and 2000+ other sites. Paste a link, or browse any site in the built-in Explore browser and download what you are watching: videos, Shorts, playlists and channels in up to 8K HDR at 60 fps, or audio as MP3, M4A or Opus. Download profiles remember how you like each download, and subtitles, SponsorBlock and partial downloads are built in. Sign in once in Explore to download private, members-only and age-restricted videos your account can watch, without exporting cookies. No ads, no upsells, and files go straight to the folder you choose.
Install
Windows Setup Windows Portable
macOS Apple Silicon macOS Intel
Linux AppImage Linux Flatpak Linux tar.gz
SHA256
Highlights
- A clearer Review. Each row has an icon, settings that are on stand out from those that are off, and a dot marks what you changed from your profile. Review opens with every row folded.
- Manual and auto subtitles together. A profile can fetch uploaded and automatic subtitles of the same language side by side, and saving a download that picked both keeps both.
- Downloads fills the window. The Downloads table uses the window's full height, and on wide windows the URL tab keeps a comfortable width.
Fixes
- YouTube's automatic captions show their language name, without a confusing "(Original)".
- An automatic caption gets the same file name and track language whether you picked it or your profile did. Embedded next to uploaded subtitles of the same language, it is marked "Auto-generated".
- Long labels on Review no longer wrap in other languages.
What's Changed
